rationale: The workflow is a GitHub Pages deployment workflow with build and deploy jobs. No supported optimization fits safely: dependency downloads are already cached via actions/setup-node with cache: yarn (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE already satisfied); there is no matrix, so P-LIT-FAIL-FAST does not apply; concurrency is intentionally set to cancel-in-progress: false for production deployments, which is a contraindication for P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE; there is no schedule to suppress (P-LIT-FAIL-SCHEDULE, P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE); there are no tests to prioritize or select (P-LIT-PRIORITIZE, P-LIT-SELECT); there is no Bazel build (P-LIT-BAZEL-*); there is no CI history to derive timeouts (P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT, P-LIT-HISTORY-TIMEOUT); path filtering could reduce required-check coverage for docs output (P-LIT-CHANGE-FILTER). The synthetic experiment evidence is explicitly not a recommendation and its timings are scenario resource costs, not this repository's CI savings.
